title: Bob Crosby's Bobcats on a cruise
summary: Hall tells of playing and whistling with the Bobcats on a Rotterdam cruise at short notice.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: No, but that was desperation. That was trying to get a job. Jazz-wise what you asked me last year. I did the Bob Crosby Bobcats on the Rotterdam cruise.
Oh, yeah, you were telling me.
So, naturally, I'm supposed to whistle Big Noise from Winnetka.
The day before I lost a tooth. (Laughter)
How did you become a Bobcat so late in life?
Yeah, I live by the telephone.
